title: common library chart values
description: Offline values contract. Components and defaults accept partial overlays; required resolved fields and references are checked while rendering. Consumer charts compose this schema with their application properties.

common.description: Helm library dependency values; configure the parent chart through defaults and components.

overrides.description: Free-form escape hatch, tpl-rendered and deep-merged onto the rendered output. Unvalidated by design.

containerDefaults.description: Policy inherited by every main, sidecar and init container before their specific values.

name.description: Container name override (tpl-rendered); defaults to the component name

volumeMounts.description: Map keyed by mount ID. Values use native VolumeMount fields, including explicit name and mountPath. IDs are not emitted.

volume.description: Map value uses Kubernetes 1.37 Volume fields; name comes from the map key. Partial overlays are validated after resolution.

ports.description: Omitted: derive all application ports. Present: select only these entries; {} derives the matching port and an empty map selects none.

certificate.description: cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. Mount its Secret using common.ref.tlsSecret in secret.secretName.

route.description: Named Gateway API route. Omitted rules derive one backend only when the default Service has exactly one port. Explicit rules are preserved; backendRefs may use component and service keys.

component.description: appResources back-ref only: back-reference scoping this route (naming, labels, default backend) to a component

parentRefs.description: Logical map keys default the parent name; explicit name allows several attachments to the same Gateway. listenerSet references a component ListenerSet; ref references appResources.listenerSet.

rules.description: Ordered native rules. Managed backendRefs accept component, service and a numeric or named port. Rules without backendRefs do not acquire a backend.
